inputs.prompt: This is an RGBA format image with transparency. The image is a realistic photograph of a single clear wine glass standing upright and about one third full of red wine. The bowl of the glass is thin colourless crystal and is genuinely see-through, so whatever lies behind it is visible through both the empty upper part of the bowl and, more darkly tinted, through the wine itself. The wine sits as a deep translucent red with a slightly darker meniscus where it meets the glass. The stem is thin and the foot is a wide flat disc, both clear. A bright narrow highlight runs down the left side of the bowl and a second smaller one catches the rim. There is no table, backdrop or surrounding scene. The lighting is soft studio light from the upper left. The overall composition is a single centred object with clear space around it. The image has an alpha channel and the background is transparent.
